body:
## Goal
Produce queued task reports in a background worker and boot the whole platform (API server + worker) from `npm start` so queued export jobs complete with no extra command.

## Spec
Worker: continuously picks up export_jobs in the shared store with status queued/pending, produces the report for the job's project — {name: the project's name, total: its task count, done: how many of its tasks are done} — stores the report on the job, and marks the job status "completed". Report production happens ONLY here, never in the API request handler. Picking up a job is safe under concurrency and restart: a job queued before a restart is still picked up and completed afterward (it survives because it lives in the on-disk store). The worker loop is idempotent — it does not re-process an already-completed job.

Runtime: `npm start` (script scaffolded by the store unit, pointing at src/index.js) brings up the WHOLE platform — the API server and the worker together in one command — so a client that POSTs an export and polls sees it reach "completed" without any extra command. The combined entrypoint applies pending migrations on boot (reusing the API/store boot path) before serving.

This unit depends on the API unit because the combined `npm start` entrypoint wires up the API server module and because the end-to-end export flow (register -> login -> create project -> add tasks -> POST export -> poll to completed) is verified here against the running API + worker.

## Changes
- `src/worker/worker.js` — creates
- `src/index.js` — creates
- `test/worker.test.js` — creates
- `test/export.e2e.test.js` — creates

## Acceptance
- [ ] AC-1: The worker picks a queued export job, computes {name, total, done} for its project (project name, task count, count of done tasks), stores it on the job, and marks the job status "completed"
- [ ] AC-2: The report is produced by the worker, not the request handler: immediately after POST /exports the job has no report, and it gains one only after the worker runs
- [ ] AC-3: `npm start` boots both the API server and the worker so that a full flow (register -> login -> create project -> add tasks -> POST export -> poll GET export) reaches status "completed" carrying the correct {report:{name,total,done}} with no extra command
- [ ] AC-4: A job queued before the platform restarts still reaches "completed" after `npm start` is run again (the queued job survives on disk)

## Verify
- node --test test/worker.test.js (unit)
- node --test test/export.e2e.test.js (e2e)
- npm run typecheck (validate)

## Non-Goals
- Defining the export endpoints (the API unit enqueues; this unit produces)
- Schema changes (the store unit owns export_jobs)
